window: First 9 hours after LightsOff (first complete 30-second epoch at or after marker). Use non-overlapping consecutive 60-epoch blocks, retaining only full blocks in PSG and within the 9-hour window. Three 3-hour strata on the resulting grid.
comparison: Same original five-person 1200-label historical anchor, subjects, recordings, per-record stratum assignments, and fixed development evaluation epochs. Exclude any candidate that intersects previously labeled anchor epochs.
draw: Independently draw one eligible block per arm/record/third, across five draws.
missing_labels: Keep fixed blind draws; exact-600 primary comparison uses only draw pairs with five-class labels at every newly selected epoch in all arms. Sensitivity includes all draws and masks unscorable selected epochs.
contrast: add_people minus deepen, and (new window contrast) minus (old window contrast).
